# Joseph and Aseneth Chapter 4 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Greek MS | **Section:** Joseph Refuses to Kiss Aseneth

---

**4:1** Aseneth came down from the upper story and stood before her father and mother. When they saw her they were struck by her beauty and rejoiced greatly.

**4:2** Pentephres said to Joseph: "Behold, this is our daughter Aseneth, of whom I told you. Come close and greet her, for she is your sister." Joseph looked at Aseneth and was deeply moved.

**4:3** Pentephres said to Aseneth: "Go and greet your brother Joseph and kiss him." She went toward Joseph to kiss him.

**4:4** But Joseph extended his right hand and placed it against her chest and said: "It is not fitting for a man who worships God — who blesses with his mouth the living God and eats the blessed bread of life and drinks the blessed cup of immortality and is anointed with the blessed ointment of incorruption — to kiss a foreign woman who blesses with her mouth dead and mute idols, and eats from their table the bread of suffocation, and drinks from their libation the cup of treachery, and is anointed with the ointment of destruction.

**4:5** A man who worships God will kiss his mother, and his sister born of his mother, and the sister of his kindred, and the wife of his bed — all those who bless with their mouths the living God.

**4:6** Likewise it is not fitting for a woman who worships God to kiss a foreign man, for this is an abomination before the Lord God."

**4:7** Aseneth was deeply distressed by Joseph's words and hurt, and she gazed at him with eyes full of tears.

**4:8** Joseph saw her and was moved with compassion — for Joseph was gentle and merciful and feared the Lord — and he lifted his right hand and placed it on her head.

**4:9** Joseph said: "Lord God of my father Israel, Most High, Mighty One, who gives life to all things and calls from darkness into light, and from error into truth, and from death into life — you yourself, Lord, bless this virgin, and renew her by your Spirit, and reshape her by your hidden hand, and give her new life by your life.

**4:10** And let her eat the bread of your life, and drink the cup of your blessing, and be numbered among your people whom you chose before all things were made."

**4:11** When Joseph finished his prayer, Aseneth rejoiced and hurried up to her chamber and threw herself on her bed, exhausted with joy and grief and fear and trembling and tears.

**4:12** After the meal was over, Joseph said to Pentephres: "I will set out early tomorrow on my journey." Pentephres said: "Stay with us today and leave tomorrow." But Joseph refused, saying: "I must leave today, for this is the day God has begun to prosper my way. But if God wills, I will return to you on my way back and lodge with you."

---
*SOPHIA: consensus rendering. Divergences logged in disagreement file.*
